title: Adjacency in a graph from a pair list
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a type, let $E$ be a list of ordered pairs from $\alpha$, and let $u,v\in\alpha$. In the simple graph generated by the unordered pairs in $E$, vertices $u$ and $v$ are adjacent if and only if either $(u,v)$ or $(v,u)$ occurs in $E$, and $u\ne v$.
